matches.stipulation: Ice Hockey Stick on a Pole
matches.note: The first to reach the hockey stick atop the octagon wins: Profusion climbs and takes it after the Slap Shot ("... Announcer: The winner of this fight, The Profusionist, PROFUSION!! The ..."); the page's own result line under the match reads "The Result of the Match is a Draw".

Stewart knocks Newbludd out with a flying kick to the back of the head ("... Shawn Stewart again calmly gets up, the ref checks on the unmoving Newbludd. Shaking his head, he calls for the bell. The Winner of the Match by "Knock Out": "Shawn Stewart" OSE is brought to ...").

Round 7 of the best-of-seven series, 3-3 going in. Kenyatta is felled by a poisoned needle from a Clan geisha's blowgun and Shigeki, the Clan's last fighter in the series, stops the count and gives up the fight ("... hand, the saliva turning the needle-point green as there were tiny amounts of the poison remaining on it. Shigeki: I... forfeit. Paulo: What? You had it in the bag, man! Referee Galenberg is confused about the whole situation, but shrugs his ...").

Taylor lost the coin toss and fights the three DaVatta Inc. members alone; Teresa Tomas draws Fatico and Frank Scarpo out of the octagon, and Taylor drops Anthony DaVatta with Off To Never Never Land for the ten count ("... Land, for Galenberg had reached ten on his count out and declared Scott Taylor the winner. Duke: He did it! He did it! He actually beat DaVatta ...").

Fought to settle the undisputed OSF Queen of Extreme. Lillith headbutts Jada Hunter unconscious and the referee, who had been knocked out earlier, calls the bell ("... lets the light play over it. The referee is on his feet, sees Jada lying unconscious, and calls for the bell. Duke: Finally. Lililth suddenly reaches down and pulls ...").

matches.stipulation: For the OSW Presidency and a Top Tier Spot in the Ascension Match
matches.note: Tempest is the guest referee. Trashcan Man wins after driving Ivan's head through the mat ("... arm over Ivan’s torso! 1…2…3!!!!!!! Ivan kicks out a second too late!!! Nate: YES!!!! FUCKING YES!! HE ..."); Alexei Ruslan hits Trashcan Man with a chair at ringside ("... Man grabs his rear end and breathes in and out through his mouth. Ruslan tears around the corner with a chair in his hand and BLASTS Trashy over the head, dropping him like a ton of bricks. ...").

Boda defends the OSW World Championship and retains: Gibson pins Timo, then Boda pins Gibson with the Super Bounced Czech ("... Three………….Johnny Jones calls for the bell, as Boda has now pinned Dave Gibson. Nate: Boda ..."; "... WINS, BODA WINS. Robbie: And there was no outside interference, like one would have ...").

matches.note: Tempest defends the OSF Championship and retains with the Glitter Grip ("... mist out of his eyes with some water from a stagehand, looks over and calls for the bell!!! Paulo: NOOO!!! Leo: Your winner… and STILL OSF ..."); Tony Travoli refereed, and was sprayed with Blitz's black mist during the fight.

Ronin retain the tag titles when Trevor Hawke taps to Matt Register's Queen Angelito stretch ("... idolize the Dynamite Kid to a certain point. With tears in his eyes…he taps. The crowd, who has been consistently loud for ..."); they give the titles up afterwards.

Forty competitors (twenty from OSW, twenty from OSF) fight on and inside a three-tier steel mountain for sixty minutes; with no one alone on top at the limit, an overtime is called, and Matt Register is the only man left on the summit ("... Riggs raises Register’s hand. Earl: Here is your winner, and the NEEEEEEW OLD SCHOOL CHAMPION, MAAAAAATT REEEGISTEEEERRRRRRR!!!! Register raises his arms in ...").
